top_signals.title: Alphabet Is Paying Up to Entice Buyers to €6 Billion Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Alphabet Inc. is set to raise €6 billion ($6.7 billion) in its second euro bond sale this year, offering considerably higher yields than in its offering in May after concerns over the pace of AI spending drove a credit-market selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: How Ethiopia’s Gas-Car Ban Sparked an EV Boom
top_signals.summary: Ethiopia became the first country to ban imports of gasoline-powered cars in 2024. Today, its EV share outpaces the global average, but the road ahead is uncertain. Can Ethiopia’s bet on EVs pay off? (Source: Bloomberg)
